purpose: Bounded method evidence, not recipe findings or publication authorization.

sources.access: Full relevant publisher article text read in web search extraction; direct open returned client challenge. Access limitation retained.
sources.section: Deflating your batter; Developing gluten; Does it really make a difference?
sources.claim: Author compared gently mixed pancakes with two-minute vigorous mixing; the latter were flatter and chewier. Gentle combining preserves bubbles and limits gluten development; small lumps are acceptable but dry flour spots should be incorporated.
sources.application: Wheat-flour pancake batter; supports avoiding needless mixing after wet/dry combination.
sources.exclusion: Not a universal stroke count, mandatory lumps, or proof for every gluten-free/creamed batter.

sources.access: Full relevant FDA page text read in web search extraction.
sources.claim: Raw flour and eggs can carry harmful bacteria. Do not taste raw dough/batter; cook according to applicable instructions and clean raw-contact equipment.
sources.application: Flour-based pancakes, waffles, muffins and quick breads.
sources.exclusion: Does not set one doneness temperature/time across formulas or validate home flour heat-treatment.

editorialChecksNotSourceClaims: Distinguish mixing stages, resting, heating, batch cooking and cooling. Include iron/griddle/tin dimensions, capacity and batch count in elapsed-time evaluation.
Preserve ingredient allocations and pan geometry under scaling; do not multiply bake time with ingredient amounts.
unknowns: Leavening balance, fruit water, rest duration, finished yield and loaf-center doneness need formula-specific evidence or test.
limits: No recipe-specific blind-reference findings used. No kitchen test. Quantities, yields, safety changes and identity changes require exception review.
